showme.untrustedWorkspaces.description: ShowMe never runs workspace code itself; it only displays, annotates and draws. In Restricted Mode it does not inject environment variables into terminals, and symbol resolution is unavailable for some languages (TypeScript/JavaScript cannot be resolved; JSON and others can).
showme.command.toggle: ShowMe: Turn on / off for this window
showme.command.teardown: ShowMe: Show teardown steps and how to remove the configuration
showme.config.stage.enabled: Let the agent open files and tabs, scroll, and split the stage (show_code opening files, show_note). When off, show_code only marks lines (the highlight appears when you open the file yourself) and show_note is refused. Annotations and the reading tools are always available. The window's .vscode/settings.json cannot change this (only user settings are read).
showme.config.stage.editorGroup: The editor group the agent draws in. `dedicated` uses a group of its own and never takes over your working column.
showme.config.html.enabled: Let the agent show HTML panels (show_html). When off, show_html is refused. The window's .vscode/settings.json cannot change this (only user settings are read).
showme.config.html.maxPanels: How many HTML panels the agent may show at once (show_html slot 1..N). Default 2. 0 means unlimited: every panel keeps its webview alive in memory until it is closed (retainContextWhenHidden), so unlimited costs memory per panel. The agent learns the limit from list_workspaces.panels.max. The window's .vscode/settings.json cannot change this (only user settings are read).
showme.config.layout.enabled: Let the agent rearrange, move and close editors and toggle views (arrange_editors, show_view). When off, both are refused. The window's .vscode/settings.json cannot change this (only user settings are read).
showme.config.layout.closeHumanTabs: Whether arrange_editors may close or move the tabs you opened, not only the panels the agent put up itself. By default it does not close them.
showme.config.layout.closeDirtyTabs: Whether arrange_editors may also close unsaved tabs. By default unsaved tabs stay, even with showme.layout.closeHumanTabs enabled.
showme.config.redactedPathPatterns: Additional path patterns to treat as redacted. This is **additive only**: the built-in default list (.env / .env.* / *.pem / *.key / *.p12 / *.pfx / id_rsa* / id_ed25519* / credentials* / *.keystore / .npmrc / .netrc) cannot be removed from settings. Matching files are refused at Location resolution and their selected text is never returned.
showme.config.maxSelectionChars: Maximum number of characters of selected text that get_editor_state returns.
showme.config.injectTerminalEnv: Inject SHOWME_SOCK into the integrated terminal. Turn it off to use only the registration-file route, e.g. when you do not want the socket path handed to other processes of the same user (build scripts and the like).
showme.config.listAllWorkspaces: Let list_workspaces return windows other than the bound one. Off by default. When on, the workspace paths of other windows become visible to the agent.
showme.mcp.label: ShowMe (VS Code stage for agents)
